whenToUse: A CRM contact list driven by saved, shared and team views with live counts.
Teams sharing filtered views by link, with unsaved changes kept explicit.
avoidWhen: A list without view management — use data-table.
Only the view switcher component — use saved-views.
a11y: The views rail is a nav with aria-current on the active view.
Make the unsaved-changes strip reachable by keyboard right after the table controls.
